column1: # Common engineering words for the word rule of the ASD-STE100 check (Rules 1.1 and 1.5): ste_check.py --words.
# Each row is a word and the published list it comes from. The FDA glossary and the NIST glossary are works of the
# U.S. Government. A NIST word is one that three entries of the glossary or more use, in a term or a definition.
# voice.tsv and project_words.tsv approve the rest of the words, and a word in either one is not listed here.
